name: Boy's Trip
source:
5 hot trans stallions. 4 tents. 1 evil bird. 

When Alex and his best friend Will go on a camping trip with some of Alex's old friends (and 1 stranger), things do not go as planned.

[From [url=https://sluttybartfast.itch.io/boys-trip-v1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
5匹热变种马。4个帐篷。1只邪恶的鸟。

当亚历克斯和他最好的朋友威尔与亚历克斯的一些老朋友（和1个陌生人）一起去露营时，事情并没有按计划进行。

[来自[url=https://sluttybartfast.itch.io/boys-trip-v1]Itch.io[/url]]
